title: f(R) Gravity (Starobinsky exponential model)
efc_relevance: Replaces R with f(R) in the Einstein–Hilbert action; produces effective scalar degree of freedom (scalaron). f(R) generically gives μ > 1 (gravity strengthened); EFC predicts μ < 1. This is a sharp sign-level discriminator (FA2 falsification criterion). DESI-DR2 analyses (arXiv:2504.05432) show f(R) is preferred over ΛCDM; EFC and f(R) therefore sit on opposite sides of the same data.
ledger_action: Logged as primary modified-gravity competitor. Already referenced in Gap Analysis §6; explicit FA2 discriminator.
